headline: Mercy arrive at conference play with one defeat
dek: The loss came on opening day, to East Stroudsburg at home; four wins and a draw have followed, the last at Southern Connecticut. Jacob Darwesh Lund-Iversen has scored eight of the eleven goals from sixteen shots, and Mercy have conceded six.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Queens have scored more than Roberts Wesleyan and Staten Island together, and nine different players have done the scoring; the spread of the attack, not one striker, is what sets them apart.

wire.line: District of Columbia have won three and lost once, on five goals scored; Lorenzo Herrera has made 31 saves behind them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches are past their date with no result published: District of Columbia's opening-day trip to Shepherd and Molloy's at Caldwell.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Daemen have conceded fifteen goals, more than any other programme, and two draws, at Saint Michael's and at home to Salem, are all they have to show.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Queens have scored sixteen goals, more than any other programme, and conceded five; the defeat at Holy Family is the only match they have lost.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: D'Youville have won their last two, at California and at home to Pitt-Johnstown, without conceding, and Matthew Solorio now has four clean sheets.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Molloy have won at Saint Anselm and now at Dominican and have conceded three goals all season; the defeat at home to Assumption is their only loss.

last_match.line: Molloy have won away at Saint Anselm and at Dominican; their only defeat came at home to Assumption, and their draws have both been at home too.

next_match.line: Queens have scored in every match this season; the defeat at Holy Family is their only loss.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
